nativeAdaptivePng.mechanism: Rex detects whole-image monochrome PNGs and uses native semantic label tint when the application switch is enabled.
nativeAdaptivePng.requiredApplicationSetting: 资源卡片 Badge → 黑白图标自适应
nativeAdaptivePng.limitation: Colored images, including white lettering within a colored logo, remain unchanged. Native runtime on the user device still requires confirmation.

browserAdaptiveSvg.symptom: All icons appeared white after SVG import and were invisible on light backgrounds.
browserAdaptiveSvg.rootCause: SVG failure itself was not reproduced in Rex; native PNG avoids that decoding path.
